hook.text: Meet the new Notion AI. One AI tool to [cycling actions] do it all.

cta.text: Try Notion AI for free at Notion.com

summary.tone: Calm, playful-minimal product launch: off-white type cards and a doodled mascot face set against bold blue and orange colour fields, carried by music with no voice-over; confident and light rather than hype.

signature_moments.description: 'One AI tool to' followed by a pill chip whose label cycles vertically with motion blur through six actions (Ask a question, Find in Google Drive, ... Draft a meeting agenda) before resolving into 'do it all.'
signature_moments.why_premium: It shows the whole feature range in one sentence-shaped animation without a list or voice-over; the blur cycling feels kinetic yet stays readable and on-brand.

signature_moments.description: The line-art Notion AI mascot face recurs (intro, beside the answering chat panel, after the CTA) and changes expression frame to frame.
signature_moments.why_premium: A tiny hand-drawn character gives the AI a personality and ties chapters together for almost no visual cost, which reads as a confident, crafted brand system.

signature_moments.description: Selecting a brief, typing a prompt that links a 'Voice & Tone Guidelines' page as an inline chip, then watching a blue AI draft stream in and turn black on Accept.
signature_moments.why_premium: Each step of the real workflow is staged with camera push-ins and clear state changes, so the benefit (on-brand writing) is shown rather than claimed.

hook.evidence: A cursor click on the logo zooms through into the mascot, then 'Meet the new Notion AI' with a drawn underline and the cycling action chip set up the whole promise within ~12 s. It is an announcement plus a bold claim rather than a pain point or striking stat.

clarity.evidence: Each feature gets a short title card (Find answers from all your apps; Write smarter, with AI that knows your style; Analyze PDFs and images; Chat about anything), then exactly one concrete, legible demo with a realistic prompt and answer. One idea per chapter, no clutter.

ui_showcase.evidence: Clean recreated desktop and mobile UI with readable prompts, streamed answers, source chips, a file drop and an Accept flow, framed by push-ins and cropped panels on colour fields. Framing is mostly static once inside a demo, and some panels are cropped hard.

motion_polish.evidence: Masked headline reveals, the blur-cycling chip, eased camera push-ins and pull-outs, typed prompts and streamed answers are smooth and consistent. Most joins are hard cuts and the title cards are largely static, so it is restrained rather than showy. Easing quality is not measured here.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from anchors only, as audio cannot be heard: a music bed at ~139.7 BPM, integrated loudness -22.4 LUFS (quiet for web delivery), no transcript words, and only one SFX candidate (x001, labelled music at 24.07 s). That means no detected UI clicks, typing or whooshes to support the many on-screen interactions. Competent music-led bed with no discrete sound layer.

vo_script_quality.evidence: No voice-over: the anchors transcript has no words. All messaging is on-screen text.

brand_consistency.evidence: One type style for all chapter cards, a consistent off-white base with saturated blue/orange/red demo fields, the recurring mascot, and Notion cube bookends (opening click, closing lockup with 'Think it. Make it.').

works_muted.evidence: The story is told entirely through title cards, typed prompts and visible answers with no voice-over, so nothing is lost with sound off.

overall.evidence: A tight 56 s feature reel with clear chapter structure, believable UI demos, a charming mascot and strong brand coherence. It is held back from best-in-class by mostly static cards and hard cuts, and by a music-only soundtrack with no detected SFX supporting the interactions.

localization_friendliness.notes: No voice-over, so only text needs translating. However, every chapter card and all the UI demo content (prompts, streamed answers, page copy, file names) is baked-in English text. Translating it means rebuilding the recreated UI and title cards, which is feasible if they are built from components, but the sheer amount of UI copy makes it costly.

pattern.why_premium: A single smooth, decelerating cursor path on an otherwise empty frame directs the eye to the brand mark and signals 'this is a product you use', with no extra UI noise.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo(cursor, {x: -360, y: 260}, {x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) ending at the logo's lower-right corner; logo stays static.

events.notes: Only the cursor moves; the logo looks static across the filmstrip. b01 (diff box around logo + cursor end) chosen for the cursor; b02 is the union of the cursor's travel path. Camera scale sum 0.709 is content-only (move none).
